{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for any non-numeric characters in the revenue column
revenue_series = sales_df['revenue']
print("Unique values in revenue:", revenue_series.unique())

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print("Number of NaNs in revenue_numeric:", sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows with the new numeric column
sales_df[['revenue', 'revenue_numeric']].head()"}
